rationale: With only 26 minutes to close and price already at 98.2% of today's range (just $0.14 below the session high), the risk/reward for a long is poor — chasing near the high with forced liquidation imminent. A short against a strong intraday uptrend (price well above VWAP at $92.17, 9-EMA at $94.34, and momentum candles showing steady grinding higher) carries equal risk of continuation squeeze. The spread and late-session dynamics do not offer a clean asymmetric setup in either direction.
